name: Open WebUI Computer (Helper Managed, No Docker)
install_cmd: ACCOUNT_HOME="${ACCOUNT_HOME:-/home/sabashop}"; [ -d "$ACCOUNT_HOME" ] && [ -w "$ACCOUNT_HOME" ] || { echo "ERROR: account home is missing or not writable: $ACCOUNT_HOME" >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir -p "$ACCOUNT_HOME/.cache/webconsole-agent"; HELPER="$ACCOUNT_HOME/.cache/webconsole-agent/install-python-agent.sh"; HELPER_URL="${HELPER_URL:-https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fazilatma/new/746cc0e4df933c5850d411a6cd591e64ef5e7012/install-python-agent.sh}"; curl -fsSL "$HELPER_URL" -o "$HELPER"; chmod 700 "$HELPER"; bash "$HELPER" install --home "$ACCOUNT_HOME" --port "${PORT:-8800}" --python "${PYTHON_VERSION:-latest}" --extras "${CPTR_EXTRAS:-base}" --workspace "$PWD" --no-start
